BB369TECH develops its own digital products and also provides implementation, website, multilingual content, and ongoing support services.Can a product be configured for one business?Implementation can include business information, branding, page structure, customer entry points, and staff onboarding.Which languages are supported?English and Chinese are commonly supported. Do not send passwords or sensitive customer records through the public form.
